name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
Lomita City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
August 16, 2010
7:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: July 6 and August 2, 2010
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report submitting contract with Arrow Parking Lot Service, Inc. in the amount of $13,950 for the resurfacing of the main parking lot at Lomita Park. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
e.
Report submitting report confirming the Mayor's appointment of Mike Savidan to the Business License Permit Hearing Board. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
f.
Report submitting a resolution approving a Letter Agreement with the Administrative Service Unit of the Lomita City Employees' Association and an amendment to Resolution No. 2010-28 (Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Lomita and the Administrative Services Unit of the Lomita City Employees' Association) providing for modification in job title for Special Projects Coordinator to Special Projects Coordinator/Information Technology Manager with a 10% salary adjustment retroactive to December 1, 2009. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
g.
Report submitting Notice of Completion from SSC Construction for Cypress Reservoir and Water Production Facility. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
h.
Report submitting Amendment No. 1 to the City's agreement with Liebert, Cassidy and Whitmore for membership in the South Bay Employment Relations Consortium (ERC). RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report submitting request to transfer an entertainment permit at the Firehouse at 24123 Narbonne Avenue from John DeCoster to the proposed new owner, Leff Enterprises. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
j.
Report submitting final map for Parcel Map 62090, a division of land for the purpose of constructing a single family residence on the new lot at 1926 W. 259th Place in the R-1 Zone. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
PUBLIC HEARING
5.
ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT NO. 2009-04 Introduction and first reading of an ordinance amending Article 70 dealing with zone change, and deleting Articles 71-81, dealing with other zoning administration matters and combining them into one comprehensive section. The proposed zone text amendment combines existing sections into one article with sections that have been reorganized and consolidated with minimal changes in the substance of the provisions.
Presented by Asst. City Manager Sugano.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
